notes: CONFLICT: Mg condition of samples 1-8 and 11-18: titles/source say 10uM_Mg (1-8) and 50mM_Mg (11-18), ch:mgso4 says 10mM for 1-8, but treatment_protocol says OFF (50 mM) = Samples 1-8 and ON (10 uM) = Samples 11-18; treatment/exposure left out for these 16 samples. All strains deltaphoPQ deltalacZYA carrying PhoQ/PhoP variants; wild type PhoQ/PhoP = reference and control. Samples 9,10,19,20 (aTc + trans-zeatin ligand of chimeric AQ4 kinase) labelled inducer_added true, treatment none; AQ4 chimera genotype_class left out (origin of the AQ4 domain not stated). Phase inferred from OD600 ~0.5 in M9, sampled 30 min after the shift. Carbon source and temperature not stated.

growth_phase.q: grown for 2 hours to reach OD600 ~ 0.5

base_medium.q: Cultures were grown overnight in M9 media containing 2 mM MgSO4

medium_class.q: Cultures were grown overnight in M9 media containing 2 mM MgSO4

amino_acids_supplied.q: Cultures were grown overnight in M9 media containing 2 mM MgSO4

strain_group.q: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655

inducer_added.q: For the OFF condition (Samples 1-8), 1 mL of cells was diluted into 2 mL M9 containing 75 mM MgSO4

transcription_arrested.q: RNA was harvested from each strain after 30 min induction with low MgSO4 or 30 min repression with high MgSO4.

mixed_organism.q: RNA was harvested from each strain after 30 min induction with low MgSO4 or 30 min repression with high MgSO4.

is_control.q: none of the six strains tested showed significant induction of other two-component systems relative to a wild-type control

assay_class.q: RNA was fragmented and cDNA libraries were prepared using the KAPA RNA HyperPrep Kit (Roche)

rrna_removal.q: rRNA was removed with the RiboZero rRNA Removal Kit for Bacteria (Illumina).

treatment.q: Uninduced samples (Samples 9,10) were generated by transferring 1mL cells to 2mL of just M9 + 1nM aTc.

inducer_added.q: For trans-zeatin induction (Samples 9,10,19,20) cells were grown in 2 mL M9 + 1nM aTc
